name: The Unspillable
tagline: A low-cost self-levelling spoon that counteracts hand tremors with two servos.
problem: People with Parkinson's and tremors spill food; stabilising spoons are expensive.
solution: An Arduino reads a motion sensor and drives two servos to keep the spoon bowl level, in a 3D-printed body.
demo_moment: Team-described: shake the handle and the bowl stays level.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Hardware Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
An affordable version of a costly assistive device.

lessons: A cheap physical fix for a daily problem demos itself.
